_comment: Map for QG8 (harness/core/scripts/doc_coverage.py). Copy to scenarios-map.json and set docs.enabled in harness.json. doc - the scenarios document, one heading per scenario matching heading. Each scenario: actor (user, admin, both, or system for a pipeline without review), files (paths or globs of the code that implements it), tests (file::name). watch - globs of code that must belong to some scenario; service - files with no behaviour people see, each with a reason; shared - common modules whose change should not wake every scenario.
heading: SC-\d+

service.src/app/health.py: liveness probe, nothing a person sees
